How each Part labels and groups effluent limitations, monitoring requirements, and other conditions

grounding.detail: page 1, section cover — cover-page authorization clause names 'effluent limitations, monitoring requirements, and other conditions set forth in Part I, Part II, Part III, and Part IV hereof' but does not map individual provisions to those categories
adjacent pages around 1 — full cover-page context confirms the tripartite reference and incorporation of Parts I–IV; no body text from those Parts is present
packet is auto-assembled from the nominated passage and may be evidence-insufficient; Parts I–IV labeling and grouping are not included

rationale: The obligation asks whether the cover-page tripartite reference establishes how provisions in Parts I–IV should be classified for enforceable numeric limits, monitoring obligations, and non-monitoring conditions. The packet grounds only the cover-page clause and its three category labels plus a forward reference to Parts I–IV. It does not contain any observation of how Parts I–IV label, group, or align their provisions with those categories. ACCEPT would require positive evidence that the cover-page taxonomy operationally classifies Part provisions; REJECT would require positive evidence that it cannot. Neither burden is met. Per P5, absence of Part-body evidence is not grounds for negative closure, so UNRESOLVED is the supported disposition.
